answer_text: To diagnose and fix slow Internet, perform a ping test and traceroute to compare latency when traffic goes through the Cato Cloud versus bypassing it to detect a sub-optimal routing path. If your Wi‑Fi signal is weak (the client reports -75 dBm or lower), that can cause slow performance and you may see a Poor Wi‑Fi notification. If issues persist, you can enable Recovery via Internet to automatically recover Internet connectivity by using ISP links, temporarily bypassing the Cato Cloud.
